title: Fire Extinguisher - Visual Condition Inspection
scope: Visual condition and documentation check of a portable extinguisher. Does not establish charge, pressure, readiness, serviceability or regulatory compliance. No removal, discharge or disassembly.
safety_notes: Do not pull the safety pin, break the tamper seal, discharge, remove or disassemble the extinguisher during this inspection.
The exploded view identifies components only. It is not a disassembly or service procedure; pressurized extinguishers are serviced only by qualified technicians.
Photos and AI observations are advisory and do not certify readiness or compliance. A qualified person makes the inspection decision.
ai_guidance: Portable fire extinguisher (safety equipment). Be conservative. Report only what is visible. Never state that the extinguisher is charged, pressurized correctly, ready, serviceable or compliant. For the gauge, describe the needle position only relative to markings that are clearly legible, otherwise ask for a better photo. Never invent unreadable text, dates or values on labels or tags. Internal condition, blockage and pressure cannot be verified from photos.

requirements.title: General exterior condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the visible exterior of the extinguisher for corrosion, dents, deformation, surface damage and missing external components.
recommended_actions: Remove from service and refer to a qualified technician if damage is found
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the whole extinguisher, from the base to the valve, in good light.
visual_limitations: Internal cylinder condition cannot be determined from a photograph.

requirements.title: Valve head visible condition
requirements.instructions: Confirm the valve head shows no visible damage, corrosion or missing parts. Do not operate it.

requirements.title: Carrying handle
requirements.instructions: Confirm the carrying handle is not bent, cracked or loose.

requirements.title: Operating lever
requirements.instructions: Confirm the lever is not bent or damaged and does not appear partially depressed. Do not squeeze it.

requirements.title: Safety pin and tamper seal
requirements.instructions: Photograph the safety pin and tamper seal together. Check that the pin is present and that the seal is present and appears unbroken.
acceptance_criteria: Seal present and not visibly broken
recommended_actions: Refer to a qualified technician if the seal is missing or broken
requirements.photo_guidance: Close-up showing both the pin with its ring and the tamper seal.
visual_limitations: A seal can only be called intact if the photo clearly shows it unbroken.

requirements.title: Tamper seal confirmed
requirements.instructions: Confirm by looking (without touching it) that the tamper seal is present and unbroken.

requirements.title: Pressure gauge visibility
requirements.instructions: Capture a clear close-up of the gauge face, if the extinguisher has one. Evaluate gauge visibility, needle visibility, legibility of markings and apparent physical damage.
acceptance_criteria: Gauge legible enough for a human to interpret
possible_findings: Needle appears outside the marked operable zone (for human review)
recommended_actions: Refer to a qualified technician if the indication is outside the operable zone or unreadable
requirements.photo_guidance: Close-up of the gauge face, straight on, without glare.
visual_limitations: A photo does not certify pressure, charge, readiness or operational safety.
Some extinguisher designs have no gauge; mark N/A with a justification.

requirements.title: Hose and nozzle condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the visible hose and nozzle for cracks, damage, missing parts, external obstruction or disconnection.
acceptance_criteria: Hose and nozzle visibly intact and connected
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the full hose and the nozzle tip.
visual_limitations: Internal blockage and operational performance cannot be verified from photographs.

requirements.title: Nozzle opening
requirements.instructions: Look at the nozzle opening and confirm there is no visible obstruction or damage. Do not insert anything.

requirements.title: Operating instructions label
requirements.instructions: Photograph the label. Check presence, legibility, visible damage and missing or obscured information.
visual_limitations: Text that cannot be read in the photo must not be guessed.

requirements.title: Inspection / maintenance tag
requirements.instructions: Photograph the inspection or maintenance tag, if present. Check presence, legibility, visible dates, identifying information and damage. If there is no tag, mark N/A and explain.
possible_findings: No visible recent entry (for human review)
requirements.photo_guidance: Close-up of both sides of the tag if possible.
visual_limitations: The tag alone does not establish regulatory compliance.
Missing or unreadable dates must not be invented.

requirements.title: Mounting and accessibility
requirements.instructions: Inspect the visible mounting arrangement and the surroundings: is the extinguisher mounted or positioned, is the bracket damaged, are there obvious obstructions?
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the extinguisher in place with its surroundings.
visual_limitations: Mounting height or accessibility compliance cannot be inferred without measurements and the applicable requirements.
